a.speaker: curator
a.text: Welcome to the Museum of Questionable Achievements! Everything in here is something Skye built, started, or swore she’d finish. Several are all three.

back.speaker: curator
back.text: Back for another lap? The exhibits haven’t moved. Mostly.

skye.speaker: curator
skye.text: Not today. But this whole building is a piece of her. Walk it and you’ll know her better than most visitors do.

tour.speaker: curator
tour.text: The Codex of Humanity is on the central plinth. The Commons is on the right wall, and the television is playing Agents of Chaos. Take your time with them.

about.speaker: curator
about.text: She keeps everything. Second Brain holds about 38,620 files of her life. Some people keep a diary. Skye built an archive with a search bar.

end.speaker: curator
end.text: Please don’t lick the exhibits. Again.
